title: Reject a missing title
summary: Spring Boot: Reject a missing title. Send an empty title and inspect 400.
introduction: A handler can check a body value and send 400 when it is not usable. Send POST /books with {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
learningObjectives: Reject a missing title with Spring Boot
Send an empty title and inspect 400

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Reject a missing title

blocks.text: The title is present and not blank, so the handler returns 201 with the book body.
Send an empty title and inspect 400.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Check input before storing or acting on it.
